fields.name: createScreen_name
fields.helpText:
The API name of the sharing set. This is a required field.


The sharing set name can only contain underscores and alphanumeric characters.


In addition, the sharing set name must:

  • be unique
  • begin with a letter
  • not include spaces
  • not end with an underscore
  • not contain two consecutive underscores
